You are investigating the Apache ECharts repository at /workspace (version 6.0.0-beta.1, TypeScript source under src/).

Requirement slug: label-layout-margin

Task: Fix/label layout margin: unify geometry rules for minMargin, textMargin, hidden-overlap handling and final label bounds after layout. Look at src/label/labelLayoutHelper.ts, src/label/LabelManager.ts, src/chart/pie/labelLayout.ts, src/label/labelStyle.ts, src/util/layout.ts. Report exact current code for margin handling, getBoundingRect/ getLocalTransform usage, shiftLayoutOnY, hideOverlap.

Do NOT modify any files. Read the relevant code carefully (use rg/grep and Read). Your job is to produce an accurate, concrete implementation plan that another engineer can apply directly without re-reading much.

Requirements for your report:
- List every repo-relative file path that needs editing.
- Quote the EXACT current code (with file:line) at each site that must change.
- Give the exact replacement code where it is under ~40 lines.
- Note related call sites / type declarations that must change in sync.
- If tests exist under test/ut/spec that relate, name them.

Be precise and complete. Accuracy matters more than brevity, but do not dump whole files - quote only the relevant regions.

input.risks:
Behaviour changes to verify:

1. `minMargin` now rotates with the label. Previously `minMargin` was expanded on the screen-axis-aligned global rect (`labelLayoutHelper.ts:141-145`); after the change it is expanded on the local rect and then transformed. For non-rotated labels the result is bit-identical. For rotated labels the global `rect` grows by roughly `halfMargin * (|cos| + |sin|)` per side instead of `halfMargin`, and — this is the point of the fix — the OBB now includes the margin at all. This makes `hideOverlap`/`fixMinMaxLabelShow` slightly more aggressive for rotated axis labels that use `axisLabel.minMargin`. The public doc in `src/util/types.ts:1331-1334` currently promises the old (screen-aligned) behaviour and must be rewritten in the same commit.

2. Scaled labels. If a label has `scaleX/scaleY != 1`, a local-space margin is scaled by the transform, whereas the old `minMargin` was in screen px. `LabelManager._addLabel` restores `label.scaleX/scaleY` from `defaultAttr` (`LabelManager.ts:404-405`) and emphasis `scale` applies to the host, not the label, so this should not bite in practice — but check `graph`/`sunburst`/`treemap` label paths if a regression shows up.

3. `refreshLabelLayoutInfoList` calls `label.getComputedTransform()`, which force-updates the transform of the label and all its ancestors. In `LabelManager.layout` this only runs when a shift actually happened (guarded by the `shiftLayoutOnX/Y` return value), so the cost is bounded, but it is not free for very large label sets.

4. `refreshLabelLayoutInfoList` re-runs `prepareLabelLayoutInfo`, which returns `NullUndefined` when `defaultAttr.ignore` is true and leaves the item at `kind: LABEL_LAYOUT_INFO_KIND_RAW`. Such items cannot be in the shift lists (`createLabelLayoutList` filters them), but do not assume the array elements stay `LabelLayoutInfoComputed` after the call if you widen its usage.

5. Do NOT tighten `shiftLayoutOnX/Y`'s `list` param to require `kind`/`localRect`. `src/chart/pie/labelLayout.ts:142` passes its own `LabelLayout[]`, which only structurally satisfies `Pick<LabelLayoutInfoComputed, 'rect' | 'label'>`.

6. `shiftLayout` sorts `list` in place (`labelLayoutHelper.ts:262-264`). Callers pass filtered arrays today (`LabelManager.layout`, pie `leftList`/`rightList`), so refreshing the same array afterwards is safe, but keep that invariant.

7. Pie: `layout.rect.width` deliberately stays the raw text width (no horizontal margin). It is consumed at `chart/pie/labelLayout.ts:232` (`realTextWidth`, positions `linePoints[2][0]`) and `:528` (`unconstrainedWidth`). Folding horizontal `textMargin` into it would shift every pie label line.

8. `getLabelMarginDelta` may return the *same array instance* as `label.style.margin` (`zrender normalizeCssArray` returns its input unchanged for length-4 arrays). `expandOrShrinkRect` copies into a module-level temp and never mutates `delta`, and the pie helper only reads indices 0/2 — but any new consumer must not mutate the result.

9. `labelStyle.ts` priority change (`textMargin` > `minMargin` > `defaultTextMargin`) makes `axis.nameTextStyle.minMargin` effective for the first time. Axis-name placement for users who set both `nameTextStyle.minMargin` and rely on the internal default gap will change; check `test/axis-containLabelAndName.html` and `test/axisLabel.html`.

10. `chart/pie/labelLayout.ts:493` (`hasLabelRotate = !!labelRotate;` instead of `||=`) is a separate pre-existing bug. Fixing it will *disable* `avoidLabelOverlap` for series where any item has a rotated label — potentially a visible change on charts that currently benefit from the accidental behaviour. Consider landing it separately.

11. `src/component/axis/axisBreakHelperImpl.ts` is not in the originally listed file set but shares the exact staleness defect; if you choose to skip it, `resetOverlapRecordToShared`'s `stOccupiedRect` (`AxisBuilder.ts:343-347`) stays wrong for axes with breaks whose labels were moved.

Unverified: I did not run `tsc` or the unit tests (task was read-only). The only import that becomes unused is `retrieve2` in `labelLayoutHelper.ts:28` — remove it or the lint step will fail.
